scope: Straight dry interior C111 partition, one 12.5 mm GSP-A layer on each face, single PN50/PS50 steel frame, no openings, joints Q1 and subsequent full-surface priming; not finished painting or certified acoustic/fire design

knauf_c11.locator: PDF page 4, C111 column, reference partition 2.75 x 4 m, no openings, no cutting loss
knauf_c11.excluded_ambiguous_rate: Joint filler 0.6 (0.9) has printed unit шт in this edition; not imported as kg. Fugen Q1 is sourced separately for each cladding face. C11 primer 0.2 l/m2 is not relabelled as kg: the selected 06/2026 Tiefengrund uses its own approximately 0.1 kg/m2 per treated face.
knauf_c11.geometry_replacement: PN and PS lengths come from the openly selected straight-wall layout, not the reference-table linear ratios. Joint tape is computed from actual vertical joints of both staggered faces, not area*1.5 outside the4x2.75 reference. Cut-edge preparation counts actual terminal cuts on both faces. TN and anchors retain the table reference quantities separately, but physical consumed pieces use ceiling and a geometric minimum: TN250mm vertical spacing with duplicated sheet-edge rows at joints, at least3 anchors per installed3m profile piece. C11 PDFpage3: studs600mm, single-layer screw step250mm, minimum3 anchors/profile, deformation joints every15m. This no-control-joint profile rejects run lengths>15m. Offcuts are not full usable stock. Assembly suitability requires project confirmation.

fugen.locator: PDF pages 2-3: Q1 joint filling 0.25 kg/m2 per cladding layer, clean water 0.6-0.7 l/kg; bags 5/10/25 kg
fugen.restrictions: Partial clean mixes permitted; water calculated from mixed required powder, not purchased bags or reserve. Thickened mortar must not be diluted again. Factory edges do not require priming before filling; cut edges require compatible preparation.

joint_tape.locator: Parameters: perforated paper, width52mm, selected roll50m; alternative150m not selected

insulation.locator: Characteristics: AkustiKNAUF 50x610x1230 mm; 16 boards, declared area12m2 per pack

tiefengrund.locator: PDFpage2: approximately0.1kg/m2 per coat, buckets5/10kg; selected undiluted non-paint finishing profile, no dilution water

krer.locator: Collection 10, printed/PDF pages 123-124, table 10-05-001, column 10-05-001-01 C111 without door openings; measure 100 m2 net partition area
krer.restriction: Labour/machines cover the whole table operation once. Modern manufacturer materials and selected cutting layout differ from the historical material column; project applicability must be confirmed. No historic prices, ceiling norm or invented per-stage labour split imported.

open_profile.sheet_layout: Opposite faces have staggered joints by600mm. Half-width first/end strips on faceB may share one source sheet where their combined width fits; offcuts within this cutting plan do not become whole-sheet inventory.
open_profile.cut_edge_priming: Visible preliminary20mm treatment band on cut top edges when height<3m and actual cut terminal strips of both staggered faces; layout and actual bevel treatment confirmed by project, factory longitudinal edges not pre-primed.
open_profile.tools: Individually disclosed preliminary contractor equipment and consumables, costs covered by selected labour/machine rates; not published consumption norms
open_profile.logistics: Materials at workplace, no separate delivery/haulage under this scope. Offcuts collected on site by contractor; external delivery and disposal require a separate selected logistics operation.

purchase: Existing automaticConstructionOwnerR1/effectivePurchaseBalanceR1; declared compatible usable stock, reserve and whole supply quantities. Sheet/stud cutting offcuts and wet Fugen do not become dry usable stock. No separate cost for labour stages included in one KRER total.
